name: Block AttnRes
tagline: Partition layers into blocks of 4; within blocks use vanilla residuals; at block boundaries attend over all preceding block outputs with learned queries.

nodes.label: Query qN ... over all block outputs

diff_from_baseline: 'Attention Residuals' (Kimi Team, arXiv:2603.15031, 2026). Memory-efficient block-level variant of attention residuals; reduces source list from 2*n_layer sublayers to ~n_blocks block outputs.

name: Learned scaling + x0 injection
tagline: Per-layer learned scalars rescale the residual stream and inject the embedding output x0 at every block; init recovers vanilla.
diff_from_baseline: Inspired by modded-nanogpt speedrun records (Keller Jordan) and Nick Ryan's 334M validation. Adds two learned per-layer scalars per block creating a 'gradient highway' from the embedding.

name: ProRes (progressive warmup)
tagline: Progressive residual warmup that linearly ramps each layer's contribution from 0 to 1 over T*layer_idx training steps.

key_hyperparams.name: $T$ (warmup period)
key_hyperparams.role: base steps until layer 1 fully on

diff_from_baseline: 'Progressive Residual Warmup' (arXiv:2603.05369, 2026). Stabilizes Pre-LN training by damping noisy deep-layer updates early, ramping to vanilla residuals as training progresses.
init_recovers: After $t \ge T \cdot n\_layer$ this reduces to Vanilla.

name: Vanilla Pre-LN residual
tagline: Standard transformer residual: each block's sublayer output is added back to the residual stream as $x \leftarrow x + \mathrm{Block}(x)$.
diff_from_baseline: Standard GPT-2 / Llama-style Pre-LN residual stream. Reference design that other baselines aim to beat.
